response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT o.recordvault AS order_reference, o.orderflow AS status, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.recordvault, o.orderflow), shares AS (SELECT order_reference, status, record_count, record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY status) AS share FROM counts), gaps AS (SELECT order_reference, status, record_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY status) AS above_average_share FROM shares) SELECT order_reference, status, record_count, share, above_average_share FROM gaps ORDER BY above_average_share DESC, order_reference, status LIMIT 10;
